title: Web console epic P3: skill buttons — enumerate available skills, run-on-click into the orchestrator session
description:
EPIC "Agentic OS web console" — P3 skill buttons. Add a panel of buttons that lets a non-technical user activate the framework's skills/commands without typing commands. Per the locked scope, clicking a button RUNS the skill immediately (sends the invocation into the active orchestrator session from TASK-051/052) — no confirmation step.

Deliverables:
1. A backend endpoint (e.g. GET /api/skills) that enumerates the available, user-facing skills/commands the orchestrator can run. SOURCE OF TRUTH: derive from what actually ships — e.g. the plugin commands/ directory and/or a curated allowlist of safe orchestrator actions (e.g. /task-status, /code-review, init/help). Do NOT hand-maintain a list that silently drifts from disk; read the real artifacts where practical. Each entry: {id/command, label, description}.
2. A skill-buttons panel in the page rendering one button per enumerated skill (label + tooltip from description). Clicking POSTs the corresponding invocation as a user turn to /api/chat/:sessionId (reusing the TASK-051 send path) so it streams back in the chat exactly like a typed command. Because run-is-immediate, the chat stream is the user's feedback that it fired.
3. SAFETY: since buttons run immediately and the orchestrator can mutate state/spawn agents, the enumerated set must be a VETTED allowlist (no arbitrary command injection from the client — the client sends a skill id, the server maps it to the known invocation; the client cannot post an arbitrary command string through this path). Validate the skill id server-side against the enumerated set; reject unknown ids.

verification_tier tests-after (the enumeration + id→invocation mapping is real logic worth a lock; the button rendering is UI). Failing-or-first specs: /api/skills returns the vetted set; an unknown skill id is rejected (not executed); the id→invocation map is covered. Minimal UI specs only. Rebuild dist/ + test:all at hand-off (bundled board entrypoint). Terse UAT: click a read-only skill button (e.g. /task-status or help) and observe it run in the chat stream; attempt an unknown id via the API and observe rejection.
acceptance_criteria: A backend endpoint enumerates a VETTED allowlist of user-facing skills/commands ({id, label, description}); the set is derived from shipped artifacts where practical (e.g. commands/ dir) rather than a drift-prone hand list, and this is unit-tested.

The page renders one button per enumerated skill (label + description tooltip); clicking a button sends the mapped invocation as a user turn via the existing /api/chat/:sessionId path so it streams back in the chat like a typed command.

The client sends only a skill ID; the server maps id→known invocation and REJECTS an unknown/unlisted id (no arbitrary client-supplied command string is ever executed through this path) — verified by a unit test that an unknown id is rejected, not run.
Run-on-click is immediate (no confirmation), matching the locked scope; the chat stream is the user's confirmation that the skill fired.
Pure-logic seams (enumeration, id→invocation mapping, unknown-id rejection) carry regression locks; UI rendering is not over-specced (new-test budget respected).
dist/ rebuilt and npm run test:all green; a terse UAT script is recorded and run with the human (click a safe/read-only skill → runs in chat; unknown id via API → rejected), all steps PASS.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Plan + tier: tests-after → single IMPL phase + minimal locks + UAT. Touches bundled board entrypoint → full test:all + dist rebuild. Design: (1) a skill catalog derived from shipped artifacts — read commands/*.md frontmatter `description` (currently apply-workflows, init-project, task-status; grows automatically as commands/ grows, incl TASK-056's /console) → entries {id, label, description, invocation='/hivemind:<id>'}; optionally a small CURATED safe-actions list (e.g. a 'help' prompt). (2) GET /api/skills → [{id,label,description}] (NOT the raw invocation — client doesn't need it). (3) POST /api/chat/:sessionId/skill {skillId} → validate skillId ∈ catalog (unknown → 400/404, NOT executed), map id→canonical invocation server-side, inject as a user turn into the session (reuses the TASK-051 send path) so it streams back in chat = run-immediately. The client sends ONLY an id; it can never post an arbitrary command string through THIS path. (4) Buttons panel in the page renders /api/skills, click → POST {skillId}. Pure-logic locks (fast tier): enumerateSkills derives from commands/, id→invocation map, unknown-id rejection. Route e2e: GET /api/skills 200, POST skill unknown→rejected, valid→200 (fake bridge — no real claude). UAT live leg (click a button → runs in chat) folds into TASK-056's live launch to avoid spending Agent-SDK credit now; the unknown-id-rejected leg is orchestrator-verifiable via the e2e.

comments.author: reviewer
comments.body: APPROVE (after one in-band MEDIUM fix). Initial: APPROVE-WITH-FOLLOWUPS, 0 HIGH / 1 MEDIUM / 2 LOW / 1 NIT. Load-bearing safety boundary verified non-vacuous: client sends only skillId; resolveSkillInvocation rejects unknown ids → 400 BEFORE any session.send (e2e fake-bridge asserts _sendCalls.length===0 on unknown, ===1 with exact invocation on known); GET /api/skills omits raw invocation; route ordering sound (/skill anchored before bare chat POST); XSS-safe (textContent+title). MEDIUM = run-immediately exposed ALL commands/*.md (init-project/apply-workflows/task-status — task-status would spawn a nested server). FIXED in-band (e363e27): listSkills now requires frontmatter panel_safe:true (the 3 current commands excluded; catalog still auto-grows for future opt-ins), curated safe set = help/status/next/new-task (conversational prompts, nothing destructive). Re-verified COLD: opt-in gate works (3 commands absent + resolveSkillInvocation('init-project')→null), panel_safe:true fixture present, 4 curated asserted, Set-dedup curated-wins, core unknown-id→no-send boundary unchanged (not loosened), NIT import folded, dist rebuilt, test:all 697 passed/5 skipped. LOWs resolved (dedup implemented); the weak /skill substring scaffold pin is pre-existing + acceptable. No residual finding.

comments.author: uat
comments.body:
UAT (tests-after) — mechanism verified by Orchestrator without spending Agent-SDK credit; the live click-runs-in-chat visual is DEFERRED to TASK-056 (live launch). Overall: PASS (mechanism).
1. /api/skills returns the vetted catalog ({id,label,description}, no raw invocation) — expect: opt-in commands + curated safe actions only; observed: e2e skill-routes + skill-catalog specs confirm the 3 footgun commands are EXCLUDED (panel_safe opt-in) and help/status/next/new-task present; invocation field omitted (asserted). PASS (orchestrator, automated evidence).
2. Unknown skill id is REJECTED, not executed — expect: 400/404 + no session.send; observed: e2e asserts unknown-id → rejected AND fake-bridge _sendCalls.length===0 (non-vacuous). PASS (orchestrator).
3. Known id runs the canonical invocation server-side — expect: server maps id→invocation, sends as a user turn; observed: e2e asserts exactly-one send with the resolved invocation; client sends only the id (no arbitrary command path). PASS (orchestrator).
4. Buttons panel renders /api/skills and click POSTs {skillId} (run-immediately, no confirm) — expect: served page wiring; observed: chat-ui-scaffold pins the skills-panel fetch + /skill POST. PASS (orchestrator, served-HTML evidence).
5. LIVE: click a safe button (e.g. Help) → it runs in the chat stream, eyeballed — DEFERRED to TASK-056 (spends a little Agent-SDK credit + needs the browser; folds into the capstone live launch). Recorded as the carried-forward leg, not a failure.
